title: Extended real number arithmetics via Dedekind cuts
summary: It is shown how Dedekind cuts can be used to introduce the extended real numbers along with sound arithmetic laws via one simple rule for the addition of sets. The crucial idea is that the use of the lower and the upper part of the cuts, respectively, leads to two different additions which are known in the literature as inf-addition and sup-addition. Moreover, the two resulting structures are conlinear spaces which at the same time are complete lattices with respect to the natural order.
